newsitem.title: USA: WMS Industries to redeem some debentures.
newsitem.headline: WMS Industries to redeem some debentures.

text.p: WMS Industries Inc said Friday its directors have approved redemption on September 22, 1997 of 33 percent of its $57.5 million outstanding principal amount of 5-3/4 percent convertible subordinated debentures due 2002.

The company said it will redeem $18,975,000 principal amount of the debentures at a redemption price of 102.9 percent of the principal amount with accrued interest to the date of redemption for a total of $336,411 or about $17.73 per $1,000 principal amount.

The debentures to be redeemed are convertible into shares of the company's common stock on September 15, 1997 at a conversion price of $23.03 per share. Debentures not redeemed are convertible at any time through November 30, 2002.
WMS Industries designs, makes and sells coin-operated and home video games, pinball and novelty games and video lottery terminals and gaming devices.
